description: Public catalogue API plus history-based recommendations. Books listing with search/filter/sort/pagination, categories and publishers lists, book detail enriched with a computed tentative delivery date and related products, and GET /api/recommendations (auth; driven by the user's order history with a popular/top-rated fallback). Depends on FEAT-002 (books/orders tables) and FEAT-003 (auth guard for recommendations). Satisfies journey items 3,5,6,7 and the base catalogue/search/filter/sort requirements.
steps: Create c:\Users\PravallikaP\Documents\FDE capstone\online_bookstore\src\api\books.ts: GET /books with query params (search over title+author, category, publisher, minPrice, maxPrice in rupees->converted to paise, sort in {price_asc, price_desc, title, newest}, page + pageSize) validated via Elysia t with sensible defaults; build a parameterized SQL query (prepared statements, never string interpolation of user input) and return { items, total, page, pageSize }. GET /categories returns distinct categories with book counts. GET /publishers returns distinct publishers with book counts.

In src/api/books.ts add GET /books/:id returning the book plus (a) a tentative delivery date = today + delivery_lead_days formatted ISO/display, and (b) relatedProducts: up to ~6 other books sharing category OR author OR publisher, excluding the book itself, ordered by rating. Return 404 { error } if the id does not exist.

Create c:\Users\PravallikaP\Documents\FDE capstone\online_bookstore\src\api\recommendations.ts: GET /recommendations protected by the auth guard. Derive the user's purchased categories/authors/publishers from their orders+order_items; recommend books in those categories/by those authors/publishers that they have NOT already bought, ordered by rating/popularity. If the user has no order history, fall back to popular/top-rated books (highest rating, in-stock). Always return a non-empty list when the catalog is non-empty.
Mount books + recommendations route modules in src/api/index.ts (.use) so they resolve under /api/*.

Create c:\Users\PravallikaP\Documents\FDE capstone\online_bookstore\src\api\books.test.ts using a temp seeded DB: GET /books returns seeded items + total; search narrows results; category and publisher filters narrow results; price range filters correctly (INR->paise); each sort order returns the expected ordering; pagination returns the right page slice; GET /categories and /publishers return >=1 entries with counts; GET /books/:id returns a tentative delivery date and non-empty relatedProducts for a seeded id and 404 for a missing id.

Create c:\Users\PravallikaP\Documents\FDE capstone\online_bookstore\src\api\recommendations.test.ts: for a user with no orders, /recommendations returns popular fallback (non-empty); for a user with a seeded order in a known category, the results favor that category/author/publisher and exclude already-purchased titles.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/books returns seeded books and supports search, category, publisher, minPrice/maxPrice (INR), sort (price/title/newest), and pagination.
GET /api/categories and GET /api/publishers return the seeded categories and publishers with counts.
GET /api/books/:id returns the book with a computed tentative delivery date and a non-empty related-products list, and 404 for unknown ids.
GET /api/recommendations (authenticated) returns history-driven results and a sensible popular fallback when the user has no history.
`bun test` passes the books and recommendations tests; `bunx tsc --noEmit` is clean.
verification: Run `bun test src/api/books.test.ts src/api/recommendations.test.ts` (and full `bun test`) and confirm all pass.
Run `bunx tsc --noEmit` and confirm zero errors.

Boot the server background/bounded; Invoke-RestMethod http://localhost:3000/api/books (expect items), .../api/books?category=<one>&sort=price_asc (expect filtered+sorted), .../api/categories, .../api/publishers, .../api/books/1 (expect deliveryDate + relatedProducts). With a $token from a registered user, Invoke-RestMethod .../api/recommendations -Headers @{Authorization="Bearer $token"} (expect non-empty). Stop the server afterward.

FILES: src/api/books.ts (bookRoutes factory), src/api/recommendations.ts (recommendationRoutes factory), mounted in src/api/index.ts via .use(bookRoutes()).use(recommendationRoutes()) AFTER authRoutes(). Both are factories taking an injectable Database (default sharedDb) like auth.ts. books.ts exports the BookRow interface (reused by recommendations.ts and tests).

=== EXACT RESPONSE SHAPES (FEAT-006 frontend MUST bind to these) ===
BookRow (every book object below has this shape): { id:number, title:string, author:string, publisher:string|null, description:string|null, price_cents:number (INR paise, divide by 100 and format as ₹), category:string|null, cover_url:string|null, stock:number, rating:number, delivery_lead_days:number, created_at:string }.

1) GET /api/books -> 200 { items: BookRow[], total:number, page:number, pageSize:number }
   Query params (all optional, validated by Elysia t; invalid -> 400 { error }):
     search    (string; case-insensitive LIKE over title OR author)
     category  (string; exact match)
     publisher (string; exact match)
     minPrice  (number, RUPEES; converted to paise via *100 server-side -> price_cents >=)
     maxPrice  (number, RUPEES; converted to paise -> price_cents <=)
     sort      ('price_asc' | 'price_desc' | 'title' | 'newest'); DEFAULT 'newest' (also used for any unknown value)
     page      (number >=1; default 1)
     pageSize  (number >=1; default 12, capped at 100)
   total is the full filtered count (before pagination). Empty filter result -> items:[] total:0 (still 200).

2) GET /api/categories  -> 200 { items: { category:string, count:number }[] }  (distinct non-empty categories, sorted A-Z, count = # books)
3) GET /api/publishers  -> 200 { items: { publisher:string, count:number }[] } (distinct non-empty publishers, sorted A-Z, count = # books)

4) GET /api/books/:id (:id numeric) -> 200 {
     book: BookRow,
     deliveryDate: string (ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' = today UTC + book.delivery_lead_days),
     deliveryDateDisplay: string (e.g. 'Tue, 13 Oct 2026', en-GB UTC),
     relatedProducts: BookRow[] (up to 6 OTHER books sharing category OR author OR publisher, excludes the book itself, ordered rating DESC then id ASC)
   }
   Unknown id -> 404 { error: 'Book not found' }. Non-numeric id -> 400 (validation).

5) GET /api/recommendations (PROTECTED — authGuard; needs Authorization: Bearer <jwt>; missing/invalid -> 401 { error:'Unauthorized' }) -> 200 { items: BookRow[], source: 'history' | 'popular' }
   source='history' when the user has non-cancelled orders and matching books exist: in-stock books whose category/author/publisher matches ANY purchased facet, EXCLUDING already-purchased book ids, ordered rating DESC then id ASC, limit 8.
   source='popular' fallback (no history, or history yields nothing new): top-rated in-stock books (rating DESC, id ASC), limit 8, also excluding already-purchased ids. items is always non-empty when the catalogue has in-stock books.

NOTE for FEAT-005 (orders): recommendations reads orders (status, user_id) + order_items (order_id, book_id) joined to books; it treats status <> 'cancelled' as 'purchased'. Keep those columns/semantics stable.
